mines.mine_notes: PFS (NI 43-101 technical report effective Jun 1, 2024, dated Nov 21, 2024): base case at US$2,000/oz Au — after-tax NPV5% US$550M (pre-tax US$656M), after-tax IRR 32% (pre-tax 34%), after-tax payback 3.3 yrs, after-tax cash flow US$871M; spot case (US$2,600/oz): after-tax NPV5% US$1,294M, IRR 62%, payback 1.5 yrs. 17-yr LOM; 50,000 tpd ROM heap leach; LOM head grade 0.32 g/t Au (0.45 g/t yrs 1-5); strip ratio 1.3:1; recovery 70.4%; LOM recovered 2,191 koz Au; avg annual 183 koz yrs 1-5, 135 koz LOM; LOM cash cost US$1,250/oz; LOM AISC US$1,381/oz (incl. Idaho Mine License Tax); initial capital US$327M; sustaining capital US$220M. FS commenced Nov 12, 2025 (M3 lead); FS results announced post-FY on Sept 8, 2026 (after-tax NPV5% US$2.4B, 60% IRR at US$3,250/oz Au) — outside FY. Also holds Goldstrike (Utah, exploration) and TV Tower (Türkiye). FY2025 exploration spend US$17.25M ($16.38M Black Pine, $0.85M Goldstrike); no production/revenue; FY2025 net loss attributable US$23.32M.
